title: {Syn} AlphaGo Combined Search With Neural Networks
content:
AlphaGo defeated Lee Sedol in 2016 by combining deep neural networks with Monte Carlo tree search. The match became a cultural marker for AI progress.

The system did not just memorize games; it evaluated positions and guided search through a vast decision space.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
